entities.summary: The Cathedral of the Most Holy Trinity also called Huancayo Cathedral is the largest church in the city of Huancayo in Peru. It is located in the west of the Constitutión Square, it is neoclassical and inside preserves paintings from the Cusco School of painting. It is seat of the Archbishop of Huancayo.
